title: A/R Detail: credit memos and deposits are plain text
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an unused credit memo {Credit-memo-A} and an unused deposit {Deposit-A} at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-10 Credits.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Customer-A} ticked and every bucket expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over {Credit-memo-A}'s number.
  2. Click it.
  3. Hover over {Deposit-A}'s number.
  4. Click it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: plain text, not a link.
  • Step 2: nothing opens: a credit memo has no page of its own.
  • Step 3: plain text, not a link.
  • Step 4: nothing opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R10: “A/R credit memos and deposits show as plain text: they have no page of their own.”
  • Out of Scope: “Links for A/R credit memos and deposits. They have no page of their own to open, so they stay plain text.”
